Overview

Olsztyn is a city in Warmian-Masurian with a population of 171,853. The gateway to the Masurian Lake District, a charming city with a Gothic castle, picturesque old town, and abundant outdoor recreation opportunities. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5a growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
